observation.launch: one bounded explicit launch of the exact M604 executable
observation.blocker: The Computer Use selection guard compared the returned process-prefixed app identifier to the explicit executable path and did not select the returned app. The preserved list_apps result contained one exact DiceBox Campaign Helper title and a second executable-title window, but no get_window, activation, accessibility capture, screenshot, or UI action was performed after the guard failed.
